items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: And I'm with the Irish and Pete.

ctx.x: He was with them. Yeah. He was with them. Yeah. So they were up at the Savoy Ballroom. Yeah. You see. We've got a little old Charlie. And I said, well Charlie. My lip is weak. But he said, well you can make it. You've got manual. And manual. The manual was very strong. The good strong drum. Yeah. So you see. He was taking care of it. And come on and started to play. And that's what I saw. So in fact. We saved that until we came out to Savoy Ballroom. And then we came out to Savoy Ballroom. And we came out to…
Manuel Perez was here then in 1928. That's right. The North's here that late.
